task: Analyze the following portfolio UI snapshot data and produce a section-keyed advisory.
instructions: Assess overall strategic condition (EMERGING/PEAK/DECLINING) from citation trends and portfolio composition
Identify strengths with metric area, evidence (trace tokens), and interpretation
Identify weaknesses with metric area, evidence (trace tokens), and interpretation
Assess licensing readiness level and justify using licensing candidate data
Evaluate competitive positioning relative strength from peer data and citation metrics
Provide a blocking_analysis interpreting blocking power drivers, dominant driver, and top patents
Provide an innovation_assessment interpreting avg innovation score, h-index proxy, and field-normalized citations
Provide a legal_health_interpretation interpreting abandoned ratio, legal strength, and maintenance profile
Provide a citation_dynamics_note interpreting forward/backward totals, self-citation rates, and distribution
Generate 2-3 strategic recommendations with action, time horizon, and rationale
Flag risks with type, severity, and reason

strengths.metric: trajectory | durability | sustainability | timing | blocking | innovation | legal | market | technology

weaknesses.metric: trajectory | durability | sustainability | timing | blocking | innovation | legal | market | technology

output_schema.blocking_analysis: string — interpretation of blocking power drivers and competitive control
output_schema.innovation_assessment: string — interpretation of R&D quality signals
output_schema.legal_health_interpretation: string — interpretation of abandonment, maintenance, legal strength
output_schema.citation_dynamics_note: string — interpretation of citation patterns and self-citation rates

trace_rules: Every narrative string MUST contain at least one [[path=value]] trace token
For strengths/weaknesses, evidence field MUST reference specific data paths
For blocking_analysis, use paths like derived.blocking_summary.dominant_driver
For innovation_assessment, use paths like derived.innovation_summary.avg_score
For legal_health_interpretation, use paths like derived.legal_summary.abandoned_ratio
